description: Main source file for controlling an LED matrix using Zephyr RTOS, including functions for setting brightness, toggling LEDs, and adjusting current limits.

methods.name: led_channel_write
methods.description: Sets all LEDs to full brightness, then disables a quadrant of the LED display.

methods.name: led_brightness
methods.description: Sequentially sets each LED to half brightness.

methods.name: led_on_off
methods.description: Toggles each LED on and off with delays.
